OVERVIEW OF GIGA-PLUS 25 BAR HIGH PRESSURE DIAPHRAGM PRESSURE TANK ｜Aquasky

 

1. Introduction to the Giga-Plus High Pressure Tank

In high-rise buildings, industrial complexes, and municipal networks, maintaining a stable, high-pressure water supply is a critical engineering challenge. Standard pressure vessels often reach their limits in these demanding conditions, risking system performance and reliability.

Aquasky addresses this challenge head-on with the Giga-Plus High-Pressure Tank, engineered for the most rigorous applications. Far more than a simple storage vessel, the Giga-Plus is a precision-engineered core component designed to deliver a continuous and stable water supply where conventional equipment falls short.

Specifically engineered to reliably withstand working pressures up to 25 bar (≈363 PSI) - the standard for high-rise potable water and industrial systems. Giga-Plus combines a robust steel shell, a heavy-duty butyl diaphragm, and a corrosion-resistant coating into a single. This construction guarantees exceptional durability, safety, and a long service life, even in the harshest operating conditions.

This article explores the advanced features, key applications, and operational benefits of the Giga-Plus series, demonstrating why it is the essential choice for water supply systems where failure is not an option, and sustainable performance is paramount.

2. Design and Features of the Giga-Plus High Pressure Tank

The operational life of a pressure vessel in demanding 25-bar systems hinges on its ability to withstand relentless structural fatigue. These applications subject the tank to constant expansion and contraction cycles, as well as powerful pressure transients like water hammer. To prevent premature failure, the Giga-Plus is built upon a dedicated material matrix engineered for resilience, ensuring long-term integrity where standard equipment degrades.

At the core of this resilience is its robust external construction. The shell is fabricated from cold-rolled carbon steel, chosen for its exceptional tensile strength to safely contain 25 bar of continuous internal pressure. The Giga-Plus shell is 60% thicker than the Mega-Plus series tanks, providing the formidable mechanical foundation required for safe, reliable operation under immense force.

To protect this strong shell from environmental threats, the exterior is coated with a triple grade paint. This advanced coating acts as a primary barrier against humidity and chemical agents in mechanical rooms, effectively preventing oxidation and pitting to ensure the shell's rated strength remains intact for years.

If you are interested in learning more about Aquasky high pressure 16 bar Mega Plus series, additional related articles are available for more information:

Mega-Plus [16 Bar] Pressure Tanks: Revolutionizing Water Management Across Industries

The Giga-Plus tank typically features two types of stainless steel connectors to cater to different tank sizes. For in-line model, a reinforced stainless steel male connector is used, which includes a plate that increases the welding circumference by 50%, enhancing the connection's strength and durability. Larger vertical tank tanks utilize a stainless steel elbow female connector, designed to simplify pipe installation and improve the overall installation process.

Internally, the Aquasky Giga-Plus tank is designed with a flexible rubber butyl diaphragm that separates the interior into two main chambers: the water chamber and the air chamber. The water chamber is lined with a seamless, corrosion-resistant propylene (PP) liner that prevents water from ever contacting the steel shell to avoid corrosion. Meanwhile, the air chamber is sealed and factory pre-charged with nitrogen to superior stability and lower maintenance needs. This chamber also includes an air valve that is crucial for making necessary pressure adjustments.

This intelligent design allows the tank to seamlessly absorb pressure swings, minimize pump cycling, and deliver hydraulic shock protection, forming a complete and reliable pressure tank with pump system foundation.

Picture 1: Cross-sectional view illustrating the internal structure and key features of Giga-Plus tank

 

3. Giga-Plus High-Pressure Tank Models by Aquasky

Selecting the correctly sized pressure tank is fundamental to system efficiency and longevity. An undersized tank leads to excessive pump cycling, causing wear and energy waste, while an oversized tank represents unnecessary cost and space. The Giga-Plus series is offered in a strategic range of volumes from 18L to 100L, enabling engineers to precisely match the tank's drawdown capacity to the specific flow demands and hydraulic profile of any project.

To suit different spatial and system layout requirements, the Giga-Plus is available in two distinct configurations, each engineered for reliable 25-bar performance.

• In-line Models (18L)

Designed for integration directly into the pipeline, the compact 18L in-line model is the ideal solution for space-saving commercial systems or as a dedicated stabilizer for critical equipment. Its design features a 1-inch reinforced connection for direct piping, making it a versatile component for boosting systems, point-of-use pressure stabilization, and protecting sensitive instruments from pressure surges.

• Vertical Stand Models (60L, 80L, 100L)

For applications requiring greater water drawdown volume, the vertical stand models provide a suitable solution. These tanks come with a fixed plastic base for stable freestanding installation and are equipped with a 1-inch elbow connection. They are the workhorses for central pressure booster systems in high-rise buildings, industrial process lines, and large commercial facilities, offering substantial buffer capacity to smooth out demand fluctuations.

4. Specialized Application Suitability of Giga-Plus Tanks in Various Industries

Giga-Plus High-Pressure Tanks play a crucial role in multiple sectors ensuring a reliable, high-pressure water supply, crucial for operational efficiency and safety. Below, we explore its applications across different industries

• High-Rise Buildings & Fire Protection Systems

In skyscraper design, vertical water distribution presents a fundamental hydraulic challenge: overcoming static head. As a practical rule of thumb, every 10 meters (≈33 feet) of elevation requires about 1 bar (≈14.5 psi) simply to lift water against gravity. For a 250-meter tower (60 – 75 floors), that equates to roughly 25 bar of static pressure before considering friction losses, control valve losses, or the minimum operating pressure required at fixtures and terminals. In this context, a 25-bar diaphragm pressure tank provides the pressure class and stability needed for high-rise distribution and high-pressure booster zones.

In residential and commercial towers, it maintains consistent pressure across all floors, eliminating weak flows at upper levels while avoiding excessive pressure at lower levels. This ensures reliable operation of appliances and fixtures for every occupant.

Its most critical function, however, is often within fire protection systems. Standpipe and sprinkler systems must deliver a required minimum pressure at the most hydraulically remote outlets, including those at the highest levels. Giga Plus pressure tank provides an immediate reserve of pressurized water, compensating for system leakage and stabilizes system pressure while the fire pump ramps to full operation. The sudden activation of high-horsepower fire pumps generates extreme pressure transients (water hammer). These shockwaves can exceed 50 bar, potentially rupturing pipes, damaging valves, and disabling the fire suppression system at the moment it is needed most. The construction heavy-duty diaphragm can act as a hydraulic shock absorber, cushioning these surges and protecting the entire piping network from destructive shock loads.

Picture 6: Reliable water support for high-rise fire protection systems of Giga high-pressure tank 25 bar

 

• Hospitals & Healthcare

In healthcare environments, water is a clinical utility. System reliability is directly tied to patient safety, infection control, and the functioning of life-saving equipment. Hospitals operate 24/7, relying on a continuous and stable water supply to support surgical suites, patient rooms, laboratories, and sanitation systems. Any failure or pressure fluctuation can have immediate consequences, disrupt critical medical procedures and compromise care delivery.

Protecting immunocompromised patients from waterborne pathogens is also paramount. The Giga-Plus features a seamless, FDA-compliant polypropylene internal liner that forms a permanent, inert barrier between the water and the steel tank shell. This prevents corrosion, biofilm formation, and metallic leaching, ensuring the potable water remains uncontaminated from the storage vessel itself.

In addition, sensitive and high-value medical equipment - such as sterilization autoclaves, dialysis machines, dialysis water treatment systems and laboratory devices - require a stable water supply. Sudden pressure surges (water hammer) can damage internal components and lead to costly equipment failure. The Giga-Plus’s robust construction and diaphragm design absorbs hydraulic shocks, protecting critical medical systems and minimizing the risk of unplanned clinical downtime.

Picture 7: Reliable water support for hospital and healthcare application of Giga high-pressure tank 25 bar

 

• Hospitality & High-End Resorts

For luxury hotels, resorts, and premium commercial spaces, water pressure defines the guest experience. Inconsistent pressure leads directly to guest dissatisfaction and potential brand damage, especially in competitive, high-expectation environments.

A premium experience is built on predictability and consistency. Guests expect immediate, strong, and uninterrupted water flow at all times - whether in showers, bathtubs, or sinks. Pressure drops during peak usage periods, such as mornings and evenings, are unacceptable in high-end hospitality settings. The Giga-Plus high-pressure tank stabilizes the entire building’s water system, eliminating pressure fluctuations caused by simultaneous demand. From ground-floor public restrooms to top-floor penthouse suites, every outlet delivers consistent, reliable, and satisfying water performance, ensuring guest comfort and protecting brand reputation.

Picture 8: Reliable water support for hospitality application of Giga high-pressure tank 25 bar

 

• Industrial & Manufacturing Water Supply

Industrial processes often depend on a relentless, high-pressure water supply for cooling, chemical processing, rinsing, and supply lines.

The Giga-Plus is built specifically for this duty cycle. Its heavy-gauge steel construction and 90°C maximum fluid temperature rating provide the durability to withstand continuous operation in harsh mechanical rooms. By maintaining stable pressure, it protects sensitive process equipment from damaging pressure transients, reduces pump wear, and ensures consistent flow for manufacturing cycles that operate 24/7, thereby safeguarding productivity and minimizing downtime.

• Commercial Boosting & Municipal Applications

For large commercial complexes, municipal water booster stations, and irrigation systems covering vast areas, the Giga-Plus acts as a hydraulic shock absorber and pump optimizer. It mitigates the diurnal demand surges that cause pipe fatigue and protects pumps from short-cycling. This application extends the lifespan of the entire distribution infrastructure, translates to significant energy savings, and ensures a reliable supply for commercial tenants and municipal users alike.

Across these diverse sectors, the Giga-Plus series delivers a common benefit: transformational reliability. By specifying a Giga-Plus tank, engineers and facility managers are not just purchasing a component - they are investing in the resilience and longevity of their most critical water systems.

 

5. Advantage of equipped Giga-Plus

The Giga-Plus 25-Bar tank delivers transformative advantages that extend far beyond simple pressure containment. Its function is to act as an hydraulic capacitor within the system, fundamentally changing the operational dynamics for greater efficiency, reliability, and cost savings. The primary mechanism driving these benefits is the reduction of pump start frequency (short-cycling), which creates a cascade of positive effects across the entire installation.

• Significant Energy Savings & Reduced Operational Costs

In systems without adequate pressure stabilization, pumps activate frequently for very short durations to satisfy minor demand, incurring this high energy penalty repeatedly. The Giga-Plus by providing a substantial, pressurized water reserve, it allows pumps to run in longer, more efficient cycles to refill the tank, rather than constantly starting and stopping.

• Extended Equipment Lifespan & Reduced Maintenance

Each pump start cycle subjects mechanical components to significant stress. The sudden torque strains bearings and seals, while the inrush current generates heat that degrades motor windings over time. Frequent short-cycling accelerates this wear, leading to premature failures, unplanned downtime, and high replacement costs.

• Enhanced System Performance and Reliability

Beyond economics, the Giga-Plus ensures the water system performs its primary function flawlessly. It delivers consistent pressure to fixtures and equipment, eliminating the user experience issues and operational risks associated with pressure instability. This reliability is crucial for both comfort in hospitality settings and precision in industrial or medical applications.

 

6. Conclusion

The Aquasky Giga-Plus 25-Bar Pressure Tank is the definitive component for resilient, high-pressure water infrastructure. It is a strategic investment in system longevity and safety, engineered to eliminate the primary point of failure in demanding applications.

Built with a heavy-gauge carbon steel shell, a durable butyl diaphragm, and stainless steel connectors, it is certified to reliably withstand 25-bar pressures and absorb destructive hydraulic shocks.
